environment: Chromium /usr/bin/chromium Linux; desktop 1280x1000; touch-emulated mobile 390x844; real iPhone/Safari untested
semantics: Main UI readings are fresh setup / start re-zero finite scans or explicitly located intrinsic components. Where available, comparison records separately show initial / retained fixture and zero / remounted readings; captureRecord, when present, gives the actual initial machine input. Product observations are not independent expectations.
